channel.title: Winnow blog
channel.description: Wallet engineering and field reports by Alex Newman.

item.title: Why Lightning Is Leaving Winnow
item.description: I added it, then took it out. The next Lightning wallet will start with a different foundation.

item.title: Why Winnow Won't Ship in China or France
item.description: Lightning has to encrypt. France wants that declared to its Prime Minister, and China wants a registered operator for an app it calls illegal. Winnow will ship to neither.

item.title: A Tailscale Workaround for Tor and I2P
item.description: Winnow still does not bundle Tor or I2P. This is how it reaches them anyway, through gateways you run yourself, and how to build those gateways.

item.title: One in Twelve Peers Is on a Dead Chain
item.description: A stalled mainnet test, a dead fork, and a census of every reachable Bitcoin node
